description: Long-lived Native Desktop performance contract gates. This layer proves the acceptance runner, stable source anchors, artifact traceability, and fail-closed metadata before any runtime evidence is trusted.

logic.question: Can the performance acceptance system identify stable Desktop interaction targets and preserve source-bound evidence without running product runtime samples?
logic.invariant: No runtime sample can be trusted when source anchors, artifact traceability, or PARTIAL/UNPROVEN semantics are broken.
